metrics.definition: Fraction of independently annotated slide, node, geometry, text-metadata, and render-extent facts matched by acquisition output.
Fraction of public corpus cases executed through the process adapter and public SightLint binary.
Expected failed bounds verdicts divided by all emitted failed bounds verdicts in this public corpus.
Fraction of cases retaining cantTell for rendered node identity.
Fraction of clean and hard-negative cases with any unexpected failed verdict.
Fraction of targeted mutations producing their independently declared failed rule target.

nonClaims: These targets are regression expectations for three public synthetic cases, not estimates of real-world accuracy.
No protected holdout, independent annotation, rendered node identity, or slide-specific recommended rule is evaluated.
A source containment failure does not by itself prove a user-facing presentation defect.
